### From `packages/core/src/llm.ts`

#### <a id="core-llmforward"></a>`LlmForward`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/llm.ts`

An LLM request forwarded from a system (behind `ctx.llm` and the aeye provider systems use).

```ts
type LlmForward = {
  request: {
    messages: {
      role: "user" | "system" | "assistant" | "tool";
      content: string | {
        type: "file" | "text" | "image" | "audio" | "video";
        content: string;
        format?: string | undefined;
        name?: string | undefined;
      }[];
      name?: string | undefined;
      toolCallId?: string | undefined;
      toolCalls?: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
        arguments: string;
      }[] | undefined;
      refusal?: string | undefined;
      tokens?: number | undefined;
    }[];
    temperature?: number | undefined;
    maxTokens?: number | undefined;
    stop?: string[] | undefined;
    tools?: {
      name: string;
      parameters: z.core.util.JSONType;
      description?: string | undefined;
      strict?: number | boolean | undefined;
    }[] | undefined;
    toolChoice?: "none" | "required" | "auto" | {
      tool: string;
    } | undefined;
    responseFormat?: "text" | "json" | {
      schema: z.core.util.JSONType;
      strict: number | boolean;
    } | undefined;
  };
  stream: boolean;
  run?: string | undefined;
  model?: {
    model: string;
  } | {
    category: string;
  } | {
    auto: {
      cost?: number | undefined;
      speed?: number | undefined;
      accuracy?: number | undefined;
    };
  } | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-llmforwardchunk"></a>`LlmForwardChunk`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/llm.ts`

What streams back: chunks, the schema descriptors the provider used (so strict output decodes), then the cost.

```ts
type LlmForwardChunk = {
  type: "chunk";
  chunk: {
    content?: string | undefined;
    reasoning?: string | undefined;
    toolCallNamed?: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      arguments: string;
    } | undefined;
    toolCallArguments?: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      arguments: string;
    } | undefined;
    toolCallMore?: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      arguments: string;
    } | undefined;
    toolCall?: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      arguments: string;
    } | undefined;
    finishReason?: "refusal" | "length" | "stop" | "tool_calls" | "content_filter" | undefined;
    refusal?: string | undefined;
    usage?: {
      input: number;
      output: number;
      cached?: number | undefined;
      reasoning?: number | undefined;
    } | undefined;
  };
} | {
  type: "descriptors";
  tools: Record<string, string>;
  output?: string | undefined;
} | {
  type: "done";
  usage: {
    input: number;
    output: number;
    cached?: number | undefined;
    reasoning?: number | undefined;
  };
  cost: number;
  interaction: string;
  model: string;
} | {
  type: "error";
  message: string;
  kind: "provider" | "limit" | "model" | "tool";
};
```

#### <a id="core-modelchoice"></a>`ModelChoice`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/llm.ts`

Which model to use: a model id, a named category, or automatic selection by weights.

```ts
type ModelChoice = {
  model: string;
} | {
  category: string;
} | {
  auto: {
    cost?: number | undefined;
    speed?: number | undefined;
    accuracy?: number | undefined;
  };
};
```
